description: Real-repository baseline for the deny list (issue 137). 16 public repositories at pinned heads: an audit, and the latest lockfile-touching first-parent commits (up to 6 each) judged against their parent the way the Action runs them, with the deny list on a trust-base commit (the parent tree plus .dep-guard.json) passed as both --base and --trust-base. Each point ran the same source build with no list and with the list; the finding diff is denied-package findings only. The npm corpus is dep-guard-core 0.18.2 data/corpus (--corpus-dir). Diff the next run against this file.
